title: A/R Collection: a customer with no phone shows no Phone label
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You call customers about overdue invoices, and one of them has no phone number on file.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an overdue invoice and no phone number on its customer card.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-02 No Phone.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s group row.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Read {Customer-A}'s line in the PDF.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: no "Phone:" label at all.
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 3: no "Phone:" label on the line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-N1: “A customer with no phone shows no "Phone:" label, on screen or in the PDF.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
